counties.notes: Oklahoma County is Oklahoma's most populous county (pop. 810,000; county seat Oklahoma City). The TaxParcelsPublics_view FeatureServer is hosted on ArcGIS Online (services8.arcgis.com, org ID euhkr1dAJeQBIjV0) and published via the OK County GIS Hub at ok-county-gis-hub-ok-co.hub.arcgis.com. Live query confirmed 336,922 parcels and owner-name exposure. Key fields: accountno (R-prefixed account number, e.g. 'R189878000'), name1/name2/name3 (up to three owners), mailingaddress1, city (mailing city), location (combined property address when populated, e.g. '123 N EXAMPLE RD OKLAHOMA CITY'), locationcity (property city), propertyid (numeric internal ID), taxdistrict, taxdistrictname, currentmarket, currentassessed, currenttaxable, landvalue, legal (legal description), subname, lot, block, section, township, range, acreage. Note: location and locationcity fields may be null for some rural parcels, when null, use legal/section/township/range for location. The former county ArcGIS Server at oklahomacounty.geocortex.com is no longer reachable (DNS fails as of 2026-06); the ArcGIS Online hosted view is the current canonical public layer. Oklahoma County Assessor portal at assessor.oklahomacounty.org provides the full record with appeals and valuation history.

Garfield County, Oklahoma (Enid; FIPS 40047) has no public ArcGIS REST service for parcels with owner names as of 2026-11-10. The County Assessor's parcel map runs on a Spatialest GeoServer (geo2.spatialest.com, workspace garfield-ok). Its feature-query service (WFS) answers 'Service WFS is disabled', while its web-map service (WMS) is up. The WMS identify request (GetFeatureInfo) does return the owner name, mailing address and values for the one parcel under a clicked point, but it returned a single parcel per request, even with a wider search window, and an owner-name filter returned nothing, so it is point-identify only: it cannot serve a radius or owner search. No statewide parcel REST service with owner names was found as of 2026-11-10. A separate ArcGIS Online item covers the Town of North Enid only (540 parcels) and is not registered. Results for 'Garfield County Land Explorer' belong to Garfield County, Colorado. Parcel and owner records are available through the Garfield County Assessor's parcel map and office.

coverage.summary: Garfield County's Assessor map can show one parcel's owner at a time, but the county publishes no query service, so we can't search by owner or radius. Use the Assessor's parcel map, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.

counties.notes: Creek County, Oklahoma (Sapulpa; FIPS 40037). Served by INCOG (Indian Nations Council of Governments, the Tulsa-area regional planning agency) from its ArcGIS Server at map11.incog.org, Parcels_CreekCo MapServer layer 0. The layer's copyright and its item's access information name the Creek County Assessor, whose Mapping Department supplies the parcels. Read as of 2026-11-10: 46,422 parcels; ownername is non-blank on 46,287; the owner's mailing street is in address2 (44,562 rows; address1 is blank on all but 344), with citystate (44,612) and zipcode (46,217); the site address, situs, is on 31,351; UPPER(ownername) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns 600, the sample query's predicate. saledate is MM/DD/YYYY text. maxRecordCount 2000 with pagination, capabilities Map, Query and Data, native WKID 26914 (NAD83 UTM zone 14N), and the server reflects the caller's Origin for CORS. EXEMPTION, FREEZE AND CAP COLUMNS, NOT LISTED: homestead, freeze, capflag, capland, capimpr, capmobh and totalcap hold homestead-exemption, valuation-freeze and assessment-cap values, so none is a search field. dataVintage.body: INCOG labels this layer 'last updated July 2023', but its rows are newer: as of 2026-11-10 it held 2,564 parcels with a 2026 sale date, the latest 09/30/2026 (2,915 in 2025 and 2,589 in 2024), and the service's item information is titled for October 2026. Read the July 2023 label as stale text.

counties.notes: Johnston County, Oklahoma (Tishomingo; FIPS 40069) has no public ArcGIS REST service for parcels with owner names as of 2026-11-11. The county's Maps page holds one voter-precincts PDF, and its E911 and GIS Office page lists no parcel layer. The Assessor's page sends the public to an actDataScout property search, and the county's links page adds CrossPointData for the Assessor's records. Both are vendor search pages, not county query services. An ArcGIS Online search found no county-hosted parcel layer: the one public service that names Johnston County, Oklahoma is a third-party account's set of boundary, district, precinct and road layers with no parcels. The Oklahoma Office of Geographic Information publishes a Statewide Parcels map on okmaps.org that covers the county, a compiled dataset provided to it by Property Records Preservation, LLC (metadata titled 'Statewide Parcels -10/03/2026'). Its metadata says 'DATA IS FOR VIEWING ONLY OR THROUGH THE OGC WMS WEB SERVICE. DATA IS NOT AVAILABLE FOR DOWNLOAD.' and that the data 'is distributed by OGI free to the public at large for view only access'. The server behind the map is a GeoServer, and we found no ArcGIS REST service on okmaps.org. It also answers feature (WFS) requests for the parcel layer, which the metadata does not offer, and under those terms we do not use them. The layer holds 11,390 Johnston County parcels with the owner name and parcel id filled on every one, and it has no mailing address and no site address column, so it could not fill a mailing list or answer an address search in any case. We do not index it. Johnston County, Oklahoma (40069) must not be confused with Johnston County, North Carolina (37101), which this atlas serves from North Carolina's statewide parcel layer. Parcel and owner records are available through the Johnston County Assessor's office and its property search. Request this county with an email address and we will send you one email when we serve it.

coverage.summary: Johnston County, Oklahoma publishes no parcel query service. The state's parcel data is offered for viewing only and has no mailing or site addresses, so we don't index it. Use the county Assessor's property search, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.
